title: Sentiment–Rating Gaps for Detecting Manipulated Product Reviews: replication package
description: Code, generated reviews, audit labels and results accompanying the manuscript 'Sentiment–Rating Gaps for Detecting Manipulated Product Reviews: Evidence from Turkish and English Data'. Includes the detection experiments, the natural-inconsistency audit, the exploratory ranking-moderation analysis (rank_v4/, EXPLORATORY) and the superseded earlier ranking experiment (legacy/ranking_v1/). Review texts of the public corpora are not redistributed.
